planets.name: TOI-1080 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1080 with a 3.97-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-1080 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1080. Its orbit and size follow Gómez Maqueo Chew et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
